verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly offer a test or sandbox API environment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt 403 probes for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, which say nothing about any sandbox or test environment. With no documented sandbox capability, the verdict is none.
